EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: WGSWD&EIP /ACQ/MH/05.
Land Min’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2012/LRB-115

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to create a water reserve and a water tank under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project.
Description of the Land to be Acquired:

Sixty eight (68) allotments of land in total extent of 9.2028 Hectares depicted as Lot Nos. 02 to 69 in the Preliminary Plan No. 9583 dated 10.12.2015 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Gangodawila in the Divisional; Secretary’s Division of Maharagama in Colombo District of Western Province and morefully described as follows:
